injuries.note: Hurt his right ankle in Adelaide’s opener on 19 September 2026 and has missed 11 games. He was available for the game against the Illawarra Hawks on 7 November but was rested as a precaution, ABC Sport’s Aaron Bryans reported. Coach Trevor Gleeson said he would “go through the checklist this week” before Thursday’s game against Melbourne United, and the club is hopeful (NBL.com.au). The NBL’s list still has his return as TBC.

Retired on October 20, 2026. Adelaide 36ers announced that a persistent knee injury had forced him to end his career, after 173 NBL games, 124 of them for Adelaide. He did not play in NBL27 and moves into a non-playing role with the club.

Out of the game against the Illawarra Hawks on Saturday 7 November 2026 for personal reasons, the club confirmed (reported by Fox Sports). The 36ers say he will return to the club next week, which points to Thursday 12 November against Melbourne United, Adelaide’s next game. ABC Sport’s Aaron Bryans also reported on 7 November that he will return from Africa next week.
Expected to miss five weeks with the ankle injury from 15 October 2026, Walshly News reported on 21 October. Archie Woodhill suits up in his place.
Still in concussion protocol and out of the game against the Perth Wildcats on Wednesday 4 November 2026, the Herald Sun reported that day. He last played on 29 October.

Hurt his lower leg against Tasmania on 3 October 2026 and ruled out for about six weeks; Mawot Mag is his injury replacement. The NBL lists Round 10, and the Herald Sun reported on 4 November he could return around the FIBA break.

Hurt against the Cairns Taipans on 8 October 2026. Brisbane expect him back in early December and the NBL lists Rounds 11 to 12; the Herald Sun reported on 4 November he could return around the FIBA break. Raul Neto is his injury replacement.
Out of both Round 8 games, the Taipans confirmed on 4 November 2026 (Fox Sports, @NBLPleb). The NBL’s list of 8 November has an ankle injury, with a Round 9 return.
Out of both Round 8 games, the Taipans confirmed on 4 November 2026 (Fox Sports, @NBLPleb).
Low-grade spinal compression fracture. The club said on 4 November 2026 he is due back 23 December, with Luca Yates his replacement.
Illawarra announced on 9 October 2026 that he will have season-ending foot surgery, NBL.com.au reported.

Melbourne United have confirmed the graft from his August 2025 reconstruction failed under rehab loading. He is having a second ACL reconstruction, 9-12 months, and is targeting a return for NBL28 pre-season.

New Zealand Breakers general manager Dillon Boucher said on 3 October 2026 that Le Gassick is managing a nerve impingement in his neck and shoulder, and that his return-to-play timeline is not yet certain, reported by Jai at Fox Sports (@NBLPleb). The NBL had listed him with an ankle injury before removing him from its list in the 26 September refresh. He has not played in NBL27.

The Breakers say James has a torn left hamstring, reported by Olgun Uluc on 16 September 2026. On 3 October general manager Dillon Boucher said James is three weeks post-injury and will be assessed at the four-to-six-week mark of his rehabilitation, reported by Jai at Fox Sports (@NBLPleb). Mojave King has joined as injury cover, and Boucher said the club will keep monitoring the import market.

Ruled out of Perth’s game against the Brisbane Bullets at Nissan Arena on Wednesday 4 November with soreness, the Perth Wildcats confirmed on Tuesday 3 November 2026, as reported by Fox Sports. The NBL’s list of 8 November has him back in Round 9. He made his NBL debut against the New Zealand Breakers on Saturday 10 October after missing Perth’s first four games.

Perth said on 21 October that he has had a setback with the injury and will be re-evaluated after the November FIBA break. The NBL listed his return as Round 11 on 22 October. The club had ruled him out on 1 October with a calf injury and a review in about three weeks. Development player Tana Kopa replaced him on the roster. He left Perth’s 97-93 win over the New Zealand Breakers on 26 September after 7 minutes and 38 seconds, first reported by basketball.com.au that night.

Perth have confirmed a successful reconstruction of a torn ACL in his right knee and say he is expected to miss the entirety of the 2026-27 season. He is a development player, announced by the club on 9 June 2026, and is not in our 12-man projected Perth depth chart. The NBL added him to its own list in the 21 September 2026 refresh.

Out of the Sydney Kings’ game against the South East Melbourne Phoenix on Sunday 8 November 2026 with illness, basketball.com.au understands. Expected back for the next game, against the New Zealand Breakers on Sunday 15 November.
Fractured fibula. The NBL said on 30 October 2026 he will miss a further six weeks, and its list of that date has him back in Round 13.

Head coach Scott Roth said after Tasmania’s loss to the Sydney Kings on Friday 30 October 2026 that Gold has been dealing with a foot problem, has not practised in about two weeks and will be shut down “for a while”. The NBL’s list of 8 November carries him as a heel injury, with a Round 11 return.
Tasmania have confirmed the knee injury is an ACL, and have signed Nick Stoddart as a Nominated Replacement Player to cover him for the Blitz and the start of the season.

Johnson left Tasmania’s loss to the Sydney Kings on Friday 30 October 2026 in the second quarter and did not return. Head coach Scott Roth said afterwards the calf injury “is going to be quite a while”.
